description: Read a whole conversation with message bodies: the tool for finding out what was said. Pass the id of any inbound email in the thread. Returns thread_id, subject, message_count, truncated (message cap reached), quoted_chars_removed and messages: every inbound and outbound message, oldest first, each with a direction and a role (inbound→user, outbound→assistant). Texts have link targets replaced by [link] and quoted history removed; full: true returns them as stored, with message ids, and quoted_chars_removed 0. A brand-new message has thread_id null and one message. For link targets, use getEmail (links: "all") or getSentEmail (full: true). A thread of only messages you sent has no inbound id: use listSentEmails and getSentEmail. Result: the conversation is in data.data.

full.description: Return the stored record, with links, quoted history and message ids, instead of the compact view for reading.

id.description: Any inbound email in the thread, by its id from listEmails or searchEmails.

name: getConversation

outputSchema.description: Envelope; the result is in data.data.

text.description: Readable text; as stored with full.

quoted_chars_removed.description: Quoted text left out; 0 with full.

title: Get conversation
